def solve(inp,N):
    H=len(inp)
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(H) if inp[r][c]]
    r0=min(x[0] for x in cells); c0=min(x[1] for x in cells)
    h=max(max(r for r,c in cells)-r0, max(c for r,c in cells)-c0)+1
    blk=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(c0,c0+h)] for r in range(r0,r0+h)]
    D=[blk[k%h][k%h] for k in range(N)]
    return [[D[min(i,j)] for j in range(N)] for i in range(N)]
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    assert solve(G[p+' input'],len(G[p+' output']))==G[p+' output']

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def rule(I,N):
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]]
    r0=min(x[0] for x in cells); c0=min(x[1] for x in cells)
    r1=max(x[0] for x in cells); c1=max(x[1] for x in cells)
    h=c1-c0+1
    B=[[I[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    return [[B[max(i,j)%h][max(i,j)%h] for j in range(N)] for i in range(N)]
print('d1:',rule(G['Demo pair 1 input'],8)==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('d2:',rule(G['Demo pair 2 input'],8)==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print('d3:',rule(G['Demo pair 3 input'],18)==G['Demo pair 3 output'])

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
